dataset_metadata.methodology: Autonomous LLM research agent + Secondary automated verification loop + Manual human spot-check audit

metrics_verification.auth_denominator: Apps supporting method out of 100 total apps (multi-method allowed)

auth_distribution.calculation_note: Percentage of total 100 apps supporting each protocol. Apps supporting multiple mechanisms (e.g. OAuth2 + API Key) count in both.

gating_distribution.calculation_note: Mutual exclusive classification across 100 apps: Self-serve (70%), Enterprise/Sales Gated (13%), Partially Gated (11%), Open Source / Local (6%).

buildability_breakdown.calculation_note: Easy (65%) + Medium (21%) = 86% Composio viable today without enterprise sales contracts.

mcp_ecosystem.calculation_note: 30 verified official/community MCP servers (30.0%), leaving 70 greenfield opportunities (70.0%).
